answer: The vine test I would run is Recognised swimming coach licence with swimming teachers attestation: a licence teachers renew after assessed lessons, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a licence teachers renew after assessed lessons stays private; the inlet is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the anchor of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
